items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: And he had a trumpet player named Bernie Priven.

ctx.x: I heard him about two years ago. He's been with the Jazz Party at Dick Gibson's.

Well, he was in that Charlie Barnett Band, and there was a great pianist in that band named Bill Miller, and I think he's out to MGM now. Man, he could play. He was a quiet little guy, and he could write. Oh, man, he could write like mad. And he had a trumpet player named Bernie Priven. I think it's P-r-i-v-e-n, I think; man, he could play. And he had a first trumpet player, a little short guy named Spots Esposito, we called him, you know.
And I tell you another great trumpet player and great arranger that was in that band, and I know you know him, Eddie Sauter.
